purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing system (JMA ORCA) - Okinawa Prefecture mental disability special treatment medical payment claim form (receipt form 121)
purpose.summary: This program generates medical insurance billing claim documents (seikyu-sho) for a specific Okinawa Prefecture mental disability special treatment category. It reads patient and insurance data, performs calculations for billing amounts, and produces printed output via the ORCA print subsystem. It is part of the JMA standard receipt software suite.

notable_features: 29 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific INC files
34 CALL statements including ORCSJOB, ORCSPRT subsystems
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing via LINKAGE SECTION
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Revision history embedded in comments spanning 2009-2014
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. Content is clearly identifiable as JMA ORCA medical receipt software. Program name SEIKYU4707 follows ORCA naming convention for billing (seikyu) programs. The '4707' suffix likely identifies the specific claim form type (Okinawa mental disability special treatment, form 121).
